quote: Full paper results, composition, source fidelity and reader delivery must all be accepted before whole-Goal completion.
application: Reader acceptance is mandatory for whole-Goal completion; this clause does not equate local independent mathematical VERIFIED with whole-Goal completion.

quote: New schema-v4 SAUs require real publication validation at PROVED_LOCAL and completed independent source review at VERIFIED / STABILIZING.
application: A layout failure waives none of the current publication metadata validation or independent source-review requirements.

quote: The verifier must name the checked commit, Lean/source gate, source audit, and fake-closure scan.
application: Independent local mathematical verification and serialized shared integration have separate evidence/ownership contracts.

quote: At stabilization, build the site once and inspect the contribution. Layout-only changes do not invalidate mathematical audits; changed source/assumptions/proof explanations do.
application: A genuine production mobile clipping failure is a real delivery defect. It does not itself refute unchanged Lean/source mathematics, and no unapplied CSS prototype can count as accepted original production.

quote: VERIFIED and STABILIZING carry that same target set and require completed independent source review.
application: Current exact public target set and completed independent source review remain mandatory; private T obtains no public API by this transition.

quote: The result is not called finished for readers until it is PURIFIED.
application: Local mathematical verification cannot be reported as PUBLISHED, merged, PURIFIED, finished for readers or whole-Goal complete.

quote: These metrics are scheduling signals, not mathematical quality scores.
application: Reader debt creates a real later delivery/purification obligation; it is not negative evidence about a separately checked mathematical proof.

quote: proved_locally, independently_verified, stabilized, merged, purified and complete main results are distinct; site status is evidence-generated.
application: The current execution contract explicitly distinguishes the proposed local stage from later delivery/completion stages.

quote: Full mains/true kernels/existence/domains/initialization/constants/error/oracle costs/composition/source fidelity/reader acceptance are required before whole Goal completion.
application: Original reader FAIL preserves publication/integration/purification/Goal HOLD and any necessary later actual delivery remediation.
